annotations.text:
People Management Platform — interactive prototype
Zinc + Blue / shadcn / Geist, matching services/frontend tokens. Each artboard is independently clickable; cross-screen navigation is not wired.

All Employees: click column headers to sort, use the filter selects and name search, switch saved-view tabs, toggle Colleague view to see the API whitelist, select rows for the bulk bar. Leave status is a synced column.

Dashboards: switch UM/DM/PM/PP presets, hit Customize to add widgets from the catalog or remove them, and New dashboard to create one from a preset with a visibility choice. People widgets carry risk, project and leave status.
Roles & permissions: pick a functional role, toggle feature permissions (Save enables when dirty), add a new role. Access roles stay derived, shown read-only.
Custom fields: Add field opens the form (options appear for select types), toggle the per-row Column switch, delete a field. Visibility drives who can filter on it.

Access preview: an HR Admin-only tool for checking the access model. Switch the audience to watch sections appear, drop to read-only, or fall out of the response entirely. S10 shows the colleague dates-only narrowing when you pick Colleague.

Self-service time off: leaves are synced read-only from the timetracker (dates, type, status) with a link-out. Flip the Demo toggle to 'Sync down' to see the stale-data banner and the 4h project-access fallback. The 'Request time off' panel (vacation / sick / move a working day) is marked Proposed — it is beyond the current pull-only spec and would need a documented write path.

Absence calendar: the org-wide counterpart to My time off — same synced source (timetracker, read-only), a month grid with multi-day bars per person coloured by leave type, cancelled leave shown dashed and struck through, moved working days as single-day markers. Page through months, filter by department or name, hit Today to return to the current month. Same 'Sync down' demo toggle and stale banner as the self-service screen.
